input.subject: No-Fee 2BR | 30-25 Steinway St | Astoria
input.bodyText:
Hi,

We have a no-fee 2BR available at 30-25 Steinway St in the heart of Astoria.

Bright corner unit, laundry in building, hardwood floors, and a quick walk to the N/W. Available Sept 1.

Rent is $54,000/yr. No broker fee to the tenant. Reach out and I'll set up a showing.

Best,
Nikolas Papadopoulos
Astoria Property Management
